title: Names used by batch p3-G02-1 (Netlas, ONYPHE, Censys Platform v3, Criminal IP, FOFA)

attributes.netlas_ioc: Netlas IOC records of the host {total, fp_flagged, credible [{threats, tags, score, first_seen, last_seen}]}: fp_flagged entries carry Netlas' own false-positive alarm (context only); credible entries are one weak vote, never a verdict (P037)
attributes.whois_network: network WHOIS record of the IP as reported by an internet-scan provider {name, handle, range, cidrs, organization, country, source}: registry data, never proof of operation
attributes.scan_engine_summary: per-provider summary of an internet-scan engine answer {provider, endpoint, window, categories {name: count}, totals, scan_labels}: what the provider holds, not what was verified
attributes.scan_threats: threats an internet-scan provider detected on services of the host [{name, port, type, source, confidence}] (e.g. Censys threats): one vote, never ground truth
attributes.criminalip_score: Criminal IP risk score of the IP {inbound, outbound, vote malicious|suspicious|benign}: one vote for consensus, never 'malicious' alone (P048 cond 4)
attributes.ids_alerts: IDS/honeypot alerts a provider recorded for the IP [{classification, message, source_system, confirmed_time}] (capped): context, never a verdict
attributes.subdomain_records: DNS records of subdomains as indexed by a provider [{domain, a, aaaa, cname, seen}] (capped): indexed data of varying age, re-resolve before acting
attributes.fofa_assets: FOFA rows for an IOC selector (capped) {total, rows [{host, ip, port, title}], capped}: observations of an unknown-tier provider, never expanded automatically
attributes.censys_web_properties: Censys web properties matched by a search [{hostname, port}] (capped): indexed observations, never expanded automatically
